description: Start each run with 1 random Common godly gift from your starting god.
2 encounters are revealed on the map at the start.
Once per run, reroll a godly gift choice.
Start with a Watchtower: shows the evil tribe's next target.
unlock_condition: Survive 3 evil tribe advances in one run.

description: Start with a Market: trade supplies for godly gifts and healing.
Start with Training Grounds: one free level-up reroll per level.
Start with a Stable: your mount is available from the start.
Ride your race's own mount instead of the Horse.
unlock_condition: Win a run as that race.

description: Any race can ride the Hyena Mount.
Any race can ride the Winged Horse.
unlock_condition: Win a run with the Lady of the Dawn or the Wind Walker.
